# edit by hand.  Each line is NAME<TAB>BYTES<TAB>SHA256<TAB>NOTE, and the hash

# The disks are not ours and are not shipped -- this fetches them from the
# original repository on the operator's behalf.  The vintage software on them
# belongs to MITS, Microsoft and Digital Research.
#
# Deliberately NOT offered, because they do not run: DISK0B, DISK0D and DISK0F
# are data companions of disks that do boot and carry no boot program; TDISK06
# is a blank.  Offering them would make this a catalogue of disappointments.
#
